# merge-profiles

<p class="meta-line">Claude Code skill · Tools: Read, Write, Bash · <a href="{{ '/artifacts/.claude/skills/merge-profiles/SKILL.html' | relative_url }}">read the full procedure</a></p>

Combines the per-tool colour profiles into a union profile showing what a chosen set of tools covers together. With no arguments it merges every analysed tool; given a paper it merges only that paper's tools; given tool names it merges just those.
